ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark gray/black) base with localized high-intensity (white) clusters; estimated macro-level ratio of 8:1 dark to light pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark gray contiguous pixel regions covering the majority of both lobes; hundreds of high-contrast white circular/annular spots (rosettes) distributed non-uniformly, with high-density mapping on the distal-third of the left lobe and distal-half of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, shallow U-shaped central depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 140 degrees with minimal vertical bounding-box depth relative to fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern; continuous sequence of jagged peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels along the entire horizontal trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the superior edges of both lobes, terminating in acute, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular white pixel rings (3-20 pixel diameters) forming dense constellations across both fluke faces, particularly concentrated along the trailing margins and distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (light-gray rake marks) visible on the mid-to-distal section of the right lobe, oriented diagonally across the darker base pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across both lobes and significant jagged irregularities/trauma marks along the continuous trailing edge contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'donut-hole' pixel patterns featuring dark-centered white rings concentrated heavily on the outer segments of both fluke lobes.
